outlook.statement: Focus will remain on sustainable growth, operational excellence, and creating long-term value for all stakeholders; significant opportunities seen in intersection of spirituality, technology, and digital commerce.
Your Company is optimistic about the coming year. Since the Company is trying to reduce cost and expand its business, your directors are hopeful that the results will be more encouraging.
With increasing digital adoption, growing participation from non-resident Indians, and rising demand

Core business of ePuja and Havans continues to anchor revenues, while new verticals—astrology, gemstones, Pandit at Home, spiritual tours, and spiritual products—collectively address markets exceeding INR 75,000 crore in size. The diversified model mitigates risks and maximizes cross-selling opportunities. As digital adoption accelerates and demand for authentic spiritual engagement rises globally, the company is well-positioned to capture significant market share.

Technology is increasingly becoming an integral part of the underlying business architecture, with potential for higher-margin, recurring and technology-led revenue streams and flexibility to leverage digital capabilities across adjacent markets.

Agro Products inclusion is an enabling measure providing strategic optionality to evaluate opportunities selectively across the agricultural value chain with emphasis on asset-light models, established partnerships, efficient working-capital cycles and technology-enabled commerce.
